content.name: Theatre Square
content.description:
贝尔兰首都的剧院广场呈矩形，尺寸为 $n \times m$。在该市周年纪念日之际，人们决定用正方形的花岗岩石板铺设广场。每块石板的尺寸为 $a \times a$。

铺砌广场所需的石板最少数量是多少？石板可以覆盖比剧院广场更大的表面，但必须覆盖广场。不允许打碎石板。石板的边应与广场的某条边平行。
content.formatI: 输入包含三个正整数：$n$、$m$ 和 $a$（$1 \le n,m,a \le 10^9$）。
content.formatO:
输出所需的石板数量。

翻译者：[jiangyunuo](https://www.luogu.com.cn/user/1061050)。由 [Lionblaze](https://www.luogu.com.cn/user/911054) 修复。

en.name: Theatre Square
en.description:
Theatre Square in the capital city of Berland has a rectangular shape with the size $ n×m $ meters. On the occasion of the city's anniversary, a decision was taken to pave the Square with square granite flagstones. Each flagstone is of the size $ a×a $ .

What is the least number of flagstones needed to pave the Square? It's allowed to cover the surface larger than the Theatre Square, but the Square has to be covered. It's not allowed to break the flagstones. The sides of flagstones should be parallel to the sides of the Square.
en.formatI: The input contains three positive integer numbers in the first line: $ n,m $ and $ a $ ( $ 1\leq n,m,a\leq10^{9} $ ).
en.formatO: Write the needed number of flagstones.
